set.body:
Goal: turn configured sample lines into native sample values without losing eye, coordinate, pupil, validity, or optional-field semantics.

Acceptance criteria:
- Left, right, and binocular layouts are parsed from block configuration; no eye is selected implicitly.
- GAZE, HREF, and RAW remain distinct native coordinate modes; only validated GAZE screen coordinates may materialize as Pt[Px].
- Pupil area, diameter, and arbitrary/unknown representations remain distinct and are never converted by assumption.
- Dot gaze values, zero pupil, off-surface positions, and native status flags follow explicit policies; missing gaze alone is not labelled Blink.
- Optional velocity, resolution, input, remote-target, and status fields are preserved when declared.
- Timestamp order is validated within the correct recording block, not across unrelated blocks.
- Exact hand fixtures and generated layout combinations cover every supported sample shape.
set.title: Parse monocular and binocular EyeLink sample layouts without coercion
